name: Agent CLI config
description: Installs coding-agent CLIs at build time — the Claude Code CLI, and optionally the GitHub Copilot CLI, with room for more to join the same install-guard shape later — and at create time wires ~/.claude and ~/.claude.json to whatever persistence and seed the consumer has mounted. A bare `{}` installs the Claude CLI and does nothing else — no seed linking, ~/.claude.json left alone. Declares no mounts: whether `${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}` substitutes inside a Feature's own `mounts` is unmeasured, so the two per-workspace volumes stay a two-line paste from the README rather than a Feature declaration that risks one shared volume across every project.

installClaudeCli.description: Install the Claude Code CLI at build time, as the remote user, into ~/.local/bin — not shadowed by the ~/.claude volume mounted at create time, and writable by that user afterwards (`claude update` etc.). Idempotent: a rebuild does not re-download when the binary is already there.

installCopilotCli.description: Install the GitHub Copilot CLI at build time, same shape as installClaudeCli. Defaults false: each agent CLI stays opt-in on its own, so enabling this Feature for Claude does not silently install a second vendor's CLI too.

claudeDir.description: Container path for ~/.claude. Empty (the default) resolves to $_REMOTE_USER_HOME/.claude at build time. An option only because an image with a different home layout exists.

seedDir.description: Container path to a read-only host config seed (see README for the mount recipe). Every top-level *file* in it is symlinked into claudeDir on every create; directories are ignored. Empty (the default) skips seed linking entirely — the Feature never invents this path, since only the consumer's own devcontainer.json can mount one in.

claudeJsonDir.description: Container path to a directory backing ~/.claude.json. A volume can only mount at a directory, which is the whole reason for this option: non-empty replaces ~/.claude.json with a symlink to "<claudeJsonDir>/claude.json", seeded with {} on first use. Empty (the default) leaves ~/.claude.json alone entirely — the plain file Claude Code creates itself, for a consumer with no volume mounted here.
